name: Orange-fronted Plushcrown
rangeDescription: Tropical southeastern colombia to northern bolivia and western amazonian brazil
description: Small, yellowish-tan bird. Orange face is unique, but sometimes difficult to see; a more obvious field mark is its bright orange legs.

name: Spotted Catbird
rangeDescription: Eastern queensland (atherton tablelands to burdekin river)
description: Chunky rainforest bird with emerald green upperparts, black spot below the dark red eye, and green-olive underparts with extensive pale spotting. Inhabits the Wet Tropics of northern Queensland (Cairns region), thus does not overlap with similar Green Catbird.

name: Yellow-rumped Serin
rangeDescription: Savanna of eritrea and northern ethiopia
description: A very plain gray-brown seedeater with a white throat and a yellow rump that is conspicuous in flight. Found locally in savanna, woodland, and cultivated areas, usually in small flocks.

name: Somali Bunting
rangeDescription: Sudan to ethiopia, somalia, uganda, kenya, and northeastern tanzania
description: A beautiful bunting of dry country. Note the black-and-white facial pattern, the gray back with russet streaks, the gray rump, and the yellow breast with pale sides.

name: Fluttering Shearwater
rangeDescription: Breeds islands off new zealand; ranges to southeastern australia and vanuatu
description: A small dark-brown shearwater with a white belly and a dusky patch under its wings along with dark markings on the inner wing visible during flight. A brown cap expands over the eye and runs down the back of the neck, blurring into the white chin and breast.

name: Dark-billed Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Venezuela to the guianas, brazil, northern argentina, and galapagos
description: Brownish above and buff bellow with a black bill, black bandit mask, and gray crown. The eyering is yellowish and the eyes dark.

name: Cinereous Mourner
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to venezuela, eastern brazil, northern bolivia, and amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized gray bird of rainforest midstory. Similar to Screaming Piha and Grayish Mourner, but has small orange spots on the shoulder and narrow yellow eye ring (those species are entirely gray).

name: Black-sided Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Montane northern borneo
description: A Bornean highland specialty, this is for the most part the only flowerpecker inhabiting the island’s montane forests. Male is striking, with a glossy dark blue back and bright red bib.

name: Rennell White-eye
rangeDescription: Rennell (southeastern solomon islands)
description: Body and head entirely uniform olive-green. Eye black with a thin bluish ring.

name: Melodious Lark
rangeDescription: Southwestern kenya, northwestern tanzania, botswana to zimbabwe and interior northeastern south africa
description: A small, compact lark with a small bill and a bold facial pattern with a distinct eyebrow. It has streaky upperparts with a distinct rufous wing panel and a lightly streaked buffy chest that separates the white throat from the creamy-buff belly.

name: Wire-crested Thorntail
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to eastern ecuador and northeastern peru
description: Small, compact hummingbird found on the east slope of Andes from central Colombia to central Peru. Male is unmistakable; look for long pointed tail, wirelike crest, short straight bill, and white band across the rump.

name: Tanimbar Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (yamdena, larat, and selaru)
description: A large, long-tailed dove. Male is boldly patterned, with dark upperparts and pale underside, each extensively covered in dark barring.

name: Cauca Guan
rangeDescription: Central cauca valley (colombia), in both the western and central andes; formerly (?) also on the west slope of the western andes
description: Large, turkeylike bird found only in western and southwestern Colombia, mostly in the Cauca Valley. Distinguished from Andean Guan by bright cinnamon (not brown) wings and tail and much larger skin patch on throat; it is also typically found at lower elevations.

name: Small Ground-Finch
rangeDescription: Arid scrub of main galapagos islands
description: A small, widespread Galápagos finch. Bill is longer than it is deep, appears somewhat pointed, and has only a slight curve to the upper edge.

name: Scarlet Tanager
rangeDescription: Eastern canada and usa; winters mainly upper amazon basin
description: Breeding males are unmistakable: brilliant red with black wings and tail. Females and nonbreeding males are dull yellow-olive with dark wings (blacker on males, grayer on females).

name: Red-naped Ibis
rangeDescription: Semiarid lowlands of india and pakistan
description: A medium-sized ibis with a dark body, often showing a bluish-green sheen. The crown and nape are covered in bright red warts.

name: Malaita Monarch
rangeDescription: Malaita (central solomon islands)
description: A small black-and-white monarch. White below except for black throat and breast.

name: Philippine Hawk-Eagle
rangeDescription: Luzon and mindoro (northern philippines)
description: A fairly large raptor of lowland and foothill forest in the northern Philippines. Dark brown above and pale brown below with a streaked head and chest and a finely barred lower belly.

name: Hodgson's Redstart
rangeDescription: Himalayas of west-central china; winters to india and myanmar
description: Male very similar in appearance to Daurian Redstart; note more restricted silver on the forehead and less distinct wing panel. Female’s lack of a white wing patch distinguishes her from female Daurian, and she averages paler than female Black Redstart, with a brighter eye-ring.

name: Montezuma Oropendola
rangeDescription: Gulf-caribbean lowlands of southeastern mexico to central panama
description: Spectacular, very large ‘blackbird’ of tropical lowlands. Favors forest edge, open woodland, plantations, semi-open areas with trees; colonies of large pendulous nests adorn tall trees.
